name: Voicebox
description: Runs a local voice studio for voice cloning, text-to-speech and Whisper dictation, and lets agents speak or transcribe through a built-in MCP server and REST API.

skills.name: Agent Voice Output
skills.description: Lets any MCP-aware agent speak in a cloned voice via the voicebox_speak tool or POST /speak, with a per-agent voice binding.

skills.name: Voice Cloning
skills.description: Clones a voice from a few seconds of audio and generates speech in 23 languages across seven TTS engines, with multi-sample profiles.

skills.name: Whisper Transcription
skills.description: Transcribes audio with OpenAI Whisper on MLX or PyTorch, exposed through the /transcribe endpoint and the voicebox_transcribe MCP tool.

skills.name: Global Dictation
skills.description: Dictates into any text field with a push-to-talk or toggle hotkey, pasting the transcript into the focused field on macOS.
